source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-8

procedures.title: Front wheel bearings: remove, inspect and install
steps: Removal: take off the hub (see Front wheel hub: replace). Throw away the old cotter pin; use a new one on assembly.
Lift the outer bearing out of the hub by hand.
Pry out the inner lip seal (discard it) and remove the inner bearing.
Clean all parts in solvent and blow dry.
Inspect: look for cracked separators and worn or pitted rollers and races; check the brake drum for scoring and out-of-round; check that the outer cups fit tightly in the hub.
Cup replacement: make press-out bars from steel bar stock as in figure 10 of the manual.
Pass the removers through the hub with their ends in the slots in the hub shoulder behind the cup.
Push the cups out using an extension pipe or rod.
Press in new cups with J-8849 (outer cup) and J-8850 (inner cup) on driver handle J-8092; keep them square and fully seated on the hub shoulder.
Installation: pack both bearings with high melting point wheel bearing grease.
Fit the inner bearing, then a new inner lip seal with its flange toward the bearing cup.
Slide the hub carefully onto the spindle.
Push the outer bearing firmly into the hub by hand.
Fit the spindle washer and nut, snug it, then adjust (see Front wheel bearings: adjust).

notes: Tools: J-8849 outer cup installer, J-8850 inner cup installer, J-8092 driver handle.
Figure 10 shows the bar-stock cup removers and a 1-1/4" dia. pipe or arbor used to press them.
